description: v1 draft. Every region PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/shadow_assassin/shadow_assassin_sheet.webp (1536x1024) by improve/shadow_assassin_palette.py: box + HSV mask + luminance-percentile band median, noted per region; 'derived' values say their rule. Palette chips (13x13 medians at y=907): #302f32, #494544, #5d5369, #837370, #ae8956 -- charcoal, dark grey, muted purple, taupe grey, gold. Glow: the blade sigils + the back-cloak sigil only (S2 default: subtle).
